An '''individual''' was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="Tatooine Manhunt" /> around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]'' is implied to take place not long after the events of {{Film|IV}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> They were armed with a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] and also carried a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] and a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].<ref name="Classic Adventures">{{WEGCite|book=Classic Adventures: Volume Three|story=Tatooine Manhunt}}</ref> During a stop in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], they encountered a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operatives.<ref name="Tatooine Manhunt" />

{{RPG}}
After exchanging friendly words with one of the Rebels, the Tatooine individual became infatuated with them and followed along with the operatives in their mission, helping in any way possible.<ref name="Tatooine Manhunt" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The admirer first appeared as a non-player character in ''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]'', an adventure book of ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' published in [[1988]]. The book instructs the gamemaster to give the character either the name "Jax" or "Jaki," dependent on the gender of the player character that the NPC interacts with.<ref name="Tatooine Manhunt" />
